headline: Singapore Meteorological Service Forecasts Rain And Warm Temperatures
metaDescription: Singapore faces a forecast of rainy afternoons and evenings for the remainder of November, alongside periodic hot temperatures exceeding 34 degrees Celsius.
aiSummaryBullets: Rainfall is anticipated across various parts of Singapore throughout the second half of November.
Showers are expected to occur primarily during the afternoons and may persist into the night.
Temperatures are projected to rise above 34 degrees Celsius on several days during the month.
aiContextParagraph: The Meteorological Service Singapore has released its latest outlook for the remainder of November, indicating a transition toward wet weather conditions. The island can expect periodic rainfall, with precipitation typically developing during the afternoon hours and occasionally continuing into the evening. Despite the increase in rainy weather, officials noted that the atmosphere will remain warm. Forecasters anticipate that temperatures will frequently reach or exceed 34 degrees Celsius on several days throughout the rest of the month. These conditions reflect typical seasonal weather patterns for the region during this time of year, characterized by a mix of convective afternoon showers and high heat. Residents are advised to prepare for both wet conditions and hot spells as the city-state concludes its monthly climate cycle, with meteorological monitoring of these patterns continuing through the final weeks of November.
whyItIsViral: 1 independent outlet is covering this story.

sources.articleTitle: Wet weather expected for rest of November, with a few days hotter than 34 deg C
